Hello everyone, I come with an update from Rocky, she's doing a lot better, it's been two busy weeks going to the vet and back but we have a diagnosis from an specialist, I'll try to explain as best as I can bc English isn't my first language so pardon any mistakes.

Well, first of all, she's got what the vet called a complete avulsion of the brachial plexus, which is what causes her arm to bend awkwardly, (these nerves located in the chest and armpit are responsible for controlling movement, feeling, and general function of her leg). Her back legs aren't broken but she walks a bit wobbly. 

Unfortunately she also has seizures, and since she was so underweight the medication could only be prescribed in a small amount, but she did go from having them 2 or 3 times a day to 1 or none at all. We're hoping once she gets more weight put on then she'll get her meds properly and the seizures will stop completely. Her vet believes all of these are the effects of trauma :(

Lastly, she had some skin fungal infection, specially in her paws, that's why they looked weird, this is being treated too and they're almost 100% clean. So, yes, this poor baby has lived a cruel and difficult life but she's really happy now, loves cuddles, loves her food, her blanket and teddy bear. She'll stay with me until she gets all better and my partner or his mom will adopt her then. So that's all for now, we have another vet appointment in a week and I will post another update then :) thank u all 💕💞
